thesis: Duties track actual understanding and influence, extending beyond blame while remaining limited.

ideas.statement: Causation, blame, immediate assistance, cost and prevention may concern different people.
Limits protect conscientious people but require justification so privilege cannot feign powerlessness.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The imaginary man outside a building needs no invented innocent biography.
Judgment cannot be reduced to a blame-measuring instrument.

audit.notes: All assigned units read. Claims remain bounded; hypothetical cases are not empirical evidence.
